mapper.select: SELECT actor_user_id,namespace,request_key FROM request_deduplications r WHERE expires_at<#{args[0]} AND (namespace IN ('DOCUMENT_CREATE','SESSION_CREATE') OR namespace='TASK_CREATE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_tasks t WHERE t.id=r.resource_id AND t.requester_user_id=r.actor_user_id AND t.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL','FAILED','CANCELLED'))) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{args[1]}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM request_deduplications WHERE actor_user_id=#{args[0]} AND namespace=#{args[1]} AND request_key=#{args[2]}

mapper.select: SELECT i.document_id,i.document_version,i.processing_revision FROM document_ingestions i JOIN documents d ON d.id=i.document_id JOIN document_versions v ON v.document_id=i.document_id AND v.document_version=i.document_version WHERE i.status='READY' AND i.created_at<#{args[0]} AND (d.current_version<>i.document_version OR v.active_processing_revision IS NULL OR v.active_processing_revision<>i.processing_revision) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_sections s WHERE s.document_id=i.document_id AND s.document_version=i.document_version AND s.processing_revision=i.processing_revision) ORDER BY i.created_at,i.id LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunks WHERE document_id=#{args[0]} AND document_version=#{args[1]} AND processing_revision=#{args[2]} LIMIT #{args[3]}

DELETE FROM context_parents WHERE document_id=#{args[0]} AND document_version=#{args[1]} AND processing_revision=#{args[2]} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chunks c WHERE c.parent_id=context_parents.parent_id) LIMIT #{args[3]}

DELETE FROM document_sections WHERE document_id=#{args[0]} AND document_version=#{args[1]} AND processing_revision=#{args[2]} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM context_parents p WHERE p.section_id=document_sections.section_id) LIMIT #{args[3]}
